description: Image Description: The image features a river scene with a bridge and several boats. In the foreground, there are two boats on the water; one is a larger passenger boat, while the other is a smaller motorboat. The bridge in the middle of the image spans the river and has multiple arches, painted in red and white. In the background, a cityscape is visible, with tall buildings, including a distinctively tall, narrow, glass-clad skyscraper. The sky above is partly cloudy
